releases.notes:
### Added
- **Passive Mob Attack Configurations**:
  - Added `enablePassiveMobAttacks` under `[behavior]` in server configuration (`petting-server.toml`), allowing server owners to enable or disable whether tamed passive mobs (such as sheep, cows, pigs, villagers) can engage in combat and attack targets. Defaults to `false` (passive mobs will not attack).
  - Added `passiveMobAttackDamage` under `[behavior]` in server configuration (`petting-server.toml`), allowing administrators to configure the base melee damage dealt by passive mobs when passive attacks are enabled (defaults to `2`, range `1` - `100`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yigit-guven/Petting/compare/5.0.1...5.0.3

- **Collar Model Visibility Configurations**:
  - Added `enableCollarModels` option under `[collar]` in server/synced configuration (`petting-synced.toml`), allowing server administrators to disable worn collar models on pets globally for everyone on the server.
  - Added `enableCollarModels` option under `[visuals]` in client configuration (`petting-client.toml`), allowing individual players to choose whether they want collar models to appear on pets on their client.

### Changed
- **NeoForge Compatibility Update**: Updated NeoForge dependency to **`26.3.0.83`** (latest recommended release for Minecraft 26.3).
- **Configuration Migration (`SYNCED`)**: Migrated server-side configuration from `ModConfig.Type.SERVER` to `ModConfig.Type.SYNCED` (`petting-synced.toml`), fixing the startup crash (`java.lang.NoSuchFieldError: Class net.neoforged.fml.config.ModConfig$Type does not have member field 'SERVER'`) caused by breaking API changes in NeoForge 26.3.
- **In-Game Configuration UI**: Updated `PettingConfigurationScreen` to properly detect and apply online dedicated server and LAN edit restrictions to `SYNCED` configurations.
- **Developer & Runtime Dependencies**: Updated Just Enough Items (JEI) dependency to `31.12.0.66` and `net.neoforged.moddev` Gradle plugin to `2.0.148` to ensure full compatibility with NeoForge 26.3.0.83.
- **Documentation**: Updated wiki and reference guides to reflect the new `petting-synced.toml` configuration filename.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yigit-guven/Petting/compare/5.0.0...5.0.1

releases.notes:
### Added
- Ported mod to Minecraft 26.3 and NeoForge.
- Modernized mod architecture and resource pipeline.
- Added comprehensive update.json for Forge and NeoForge update checker.
- Added configurable friendly fire settings (`[friendlyFire]` in server config):
  - `ownerCanAttackPets`: Configures whether owners can attack and damage their own pets (default: `true`). Pets will still never attack or target their owner under any circumstances.
  - `petsCanAttackPets`: Configures whether pets belonging to the same owner can target or attack each other (default: `false`).
- Streamlined and modernized server configuration (`[behavior]` and `[collar]`):
  - Consolidated tactical AI settings to eliminate duplication between global configs and per-collar settings.
  - Removed obsolete fields (`petsDefendOwner`, `petsAttackOwnerTarget`, `petsRetaliate`, `teleportDistance`) from `[behavior]`.
  - Moved `defaultCombatMode` under `[collar]` and provided comprehensive collar defaults and slider boundary controls (`defaultCombatMode`, `defaultFollowDistance`, `minFollowDistance`, `maxFollowDistance`, `defaultTeleportDistance`, `minTeleportDistance`, `maxTeleportDistance`, `defaultTeleportEnabled`, `defaultPreferRangedAttack`, `defaultDefendOtherPets`, `defaultRetaliateWhenHurt`).
  - Added full translation keys and descriptive tooltips for NeoForge's in-game config UI (`ConfigurationSectionScreen`).
- Added universal Pet Sitting system with dedicated keybind:
  - **Sit / Stand Keybind (`key.petting.toggle_pet_sit`)**: Defaults to **Right-Click** (`MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT`). Remappable in Controls -> Key Binds -> Petting.
  - Context-aware interaction: Automatically prioritizes item interactions (equipping collars, dyeing collars, feeding treats, naming with name tags, leashing, shearing) so held items function as expected.
  - Vanilla `TamableAnimal` pets (wolves, cats) visually transition into sitting poses when sitting.
  - **Boat/Minecart Sitting Pose for Humanoid & Illager Pets**: When ordered to sit, humanoid mobs (Zombies, Husks, Drowned, Zombie Villagers, Skeletons, Strays, Wither Skeletons, Bogged, Piglins, Piglin Brutes, Zombified Piglins, Endermen, Players) and Illagers (Pillagers, Vindicators, Evokers, Illusioners) adopt their iconic boat / minecart riding shape with outstretched legs and passenger arm poses. When stationed on the ground, their rendered body and floating nametag are seamlessly lowered so they sit realistically on the ground rather than floating in mid-air.
  - **Special Animal Sitting Support**: Animals with sitting poses (such as Foxes, Pandas, and Camels) seamlessly trigger their sitting animations when ordered to sit.
  - **Hovering physics for flying pets**: Flying pets (Allays, Ghasts, Phantoms, Bats, Bees, Parrots, Blazes, Withers, Vexes, etc.) hover completely motionless in mid-air right where commanded to sit.
  - **Stillness physics for aquatic pets**: Swimming pets (and any pet submerged in water) remain completely stationary without sinking, floating up, or drifting in currents.
  - **Walking pets**: Remain firmly stationed on the ground like a sitting wolf in vanilla Minecraft.
  - **Sitting Nametag Dimming (Sneak Visuals)**: When a named pet is sitting, its floating nametag text becomes darker and translucent (and suppresses see-through through walls) just like a crouching/sneaking player in vanilla Minecraft.
  - **Combat forgiveness on sit**: Ordering a pet to sit immediately clears attack targets, erases anger, halts attack goals, and suspends following and teleporting.
  - Fully configurable in server configuration (`[behavior]`):
    - `enablePetSitting`: Enable or disable the pet sitting mechanic globally (default: `true`).
    - `enablePetInventory`: Configures whether the entire pet inventory, equipment, and riding system is enabled (default: `true`). When set to `false`, pets operate purely on default configuration settings without collar/equipment support or riding.

releases.notes:
# Petting 4.2.3-beta.6

## Features & Additions:
- **Pet Bed Recipe**: Added the missing shaped crafting recipe for the Pet Bed (`data/petting/recipes/pet_bed.json`) using wool and planks.
- **Custom Taming Items Support**: Fully wired the `CUSTOM_TAMING_ITEMS` configuration option (`entity_registry|item_registry`), allowing modpack authors to define custom items to tame specific entities even when Golden Wheat is disabled.
- **Wearable Items Equipment Support**: Expanded pet equipment slots to support non-armor wearable items (such as elytra, carved pumpkins, and mob heads) via `LivingEntity.getEquipmentSlotForItem` for both direct placement and shift-click quick move.

## Bug Fixes:
- **Owner Friendly-Fire Fix**: Prevented owners from inadvertently damaging their pets while on foot or shooting projectiles when `ALLOW_OWNER_TO_HURT_PETS` is false (previously only checked while riding).
- **Environmental Invulnerability Fix**: Replaced duplicate `IS_FIRE` damage tags in `PetAttackLogic` with `IS_DROWNING` and `IS_FREEZING` to protect custom pets from drowning or freezing to death.
- **Duplicate Sitting Heal Fix**: Removed redundant sit-healing loop in `FollowOwnerOrTeleport` that bypassed the `SIT_HEAL_ENABLED` config setting (sit-healing is properly governed by `EntityTickUpdateProcedure`).
- **Pet Bed Respawn Validation**: Added block validation in `PetDeathHandlerProcedure` to verify that the Pet Bed still exists in the destination world. If destroyed or broken, the owner is notified, bed coordinates are cleaned up, and standard death handling proceeds.
- **Mob Conversion Sync & Inventory Transfer**: Ensured `ignoreWhistle`, `control_right_click`, and `control_shift_right_click` are preserved during mob conversion, and transferred pet inventory capability contents between original and converted entities.
- **Pet Release Data Cleanup**: Releasing a pet with shears now cleans up stored pet bed coordinates (`pet_bed_loc_x/y/z/dim`) and control mappings, and untames vanilla `TamableAnimal` instances.
- **Immediate Tamed Persistence**: Ensured newly tamed mobs immediately receive `setPersistenceRequired()`, preventing them from despawning.
- **Whistle Crouch Requirement**: Enforced sneaking requirement (`player.isShiftKeyDown()`) when sounding the Goat Horn / Whistle tool, matching configuration docs and preventing unintended mass summons.

## Performance Optimizations:
- **Temptation Tick Optimization**: Players now cache `pettingHoldingGoldenWheat` so the server skips entity AABB scans when the player is not holding golden wheat, and search radius is tightened to 12 blocks.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yigit-guven/Petting/compare/4.2.3-beta.4-forge-1.20.1...4.2.3-beta.6
